measured: spectral sensitivity, one panchromatic layer, as printed (high confidence)
characteristic curve, visual density, as printed (high confidence), less its base and fog
inferred: the layer's sensitivity past the sheet's first and last point, falling at its end slope
the layer's level: set by the bake so a grey under daylight exposes it at log 0
the curve smoothed over 0.05 log H, lifting a raster trace's steps
the development: d76_6min, its ISO 6 average gradient 0.55 the nearest the sheet's developer prints to ISO 6's 0.62
the grey's exposure: ISO 6 speed point + 1.01 log, where ISO 6's speed and ISO 2720's meter put a metered grey
densities held at the sheet's last point past the curve's printed range
every other development on the default's log H axis, less its grey: one sheet's axis is shared
